cohort: The study included 42,301 births from two university hospitals in Romania between 2005 and 2015, comprising cases with both intact and cicatriceal uteri.
finding: A significantly increased risk (RR=9.5) for hemostatic postpartum hysterectomy was detected in patients with cicatriceal uterus and placenta previa, with increased incidence of placenta previa also observed in women aged 31-40 years with high gestation and parity.
mod_finding: The study recommends rigorous selection of caesarian section indication to decrease the incidence of cicatriceal uterus and its potential association with placenta previa.
